Important Notice
Regarding Recruitment
to the Posts
of
Associate Professor and Professor
in
Hindi Subject
With reference to Advertisement
No.
CSJMU/Gen.Admin/32/01-Teaching/ 2026dated 24.01.2026
and the subsequent
Recruitment
Notice No.
CSJMU/Gen.Admin/
980/Teaching/2026 dated
26.09.2026, it is hereby informed
that
candidates
who
have
already applied for
the posts of Associate Professor
and
Professor
in
Hindi
under
the
earlier advertisement are not
required to
submit
fresh applications.
Such candidates may
log
in
to
the Samarth recruitment portal
using their
existinglogin credentials
and
update their
previously
submitted
applications, wherever required.The
last date
for
updating
the
existing application shall be
the same
as the last
date
prescribed in the latest recruitment notice
dated
26.09.2026.
